The role of attractive ('A') and repulsive ('B') interactions in determining the aggregate structure. c. Insights gained from previous iterations, including patterns or motifs that lead to lower distances. d. The need to explore diverse sequences while also refining promising solutions. Remember to maintain a clear and concise format for your proposed sequences and explanations.
